Harbourstone Distillery: a coastal distillery: a range with tasting-note elements, reusable highlights, a contact form, photographs and a stylesheet.

Create it

mkdir harbourstone && cd harbourstone
bunx @crombolo/cli@latest init --template demo/harbourstone
bun install

Start it

bun start

The site is served on http://localhost:8080/.

The first start applies the template's content and publishes it. The back office is at http://localhost:8080/crombolo, and the start prints how to sign in (Getting started).

The bundles it brings

  • @crombolo/simple-redirects

They are installed with the site, and wired in its crombolo.config.ts.

What is in it

  • a coastal distillery's brochure site: a home page, an about page, its bottlings with tasting notes, a comparison of bottlings, search, and a contact page;
  • reusable highlights kept in the Library, and a highlight block (components/blocks/highlight.tsx);
  • a contact form, photographs with their credits, and a stylesheet;
  • the simple redirects bundle.

Where to look first

components/pages/ holds a view for each page type. bunx crombolo site show lists its types, forms and groups, and bunx crombolo types show expression shows how a bottling is put together.
